question: Should OpenClaw accept `authBootstrap: "harness"` plus Codex harness-owned auth routing as the long-term plugin SDK boundary for fresh macOS Codex onboarding?
rationale: The code path is now well-proven, but the new auth-bootstrap seam affects plugin SDK, auth-provider routing, and persisted setup behavior in a way automation cannot decide as product/API direction.

options.title: Accept harness-owned Codex auth
options.body: Land the PR after removing the changelog edit and refreshing checks, treating the documented optional harness flag as the supported seam for trusted native runtimes.

options.title: Move auth bootstrap back to core
options.body: Ask for a redesign that preserves core-owned OpenAI credential bootstrap and solves the Codex onboarding bug without a new harness auth contract.

options.title: Pause for broader onboarding design
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers settle Codex runtime pin persistence and plugin enablement policy across sibling setup flows.

recommendation.title: Accept harness-owned Codex auth
recommendation.body: Land the PR after removing the changelog edit and refreshing checks, treating the documented optional harness flag as the supported seam for trusted native runtimes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest merged-history owner for the Codex app-server harness and macOS onboarding paths, and the live PR assignee for this decision.
